title: Envato Elements Pricing vs Adobe Stock in 2026
summary: Envato Elements pricing structures vary by individual or team needs, allowing you to choose the subscription that aligns with your project budget.
body_markdown:
## Envato Elements pricing for individuals and teams


Plan Type Monthly Cost (Billed Annually) AI Credits Library Access


Individual $16.50 / month Unlimited Downloads (Fair Use Policy) Full Library


Student $11.50 / month Unlimited Downloads (Fair Use Policy) Full Library


Team From $10.75 / member Shared Licence (Unlimited Downloads) Full Library


This structure ensures that the barrier to entry remains low for solo practitioners while providing a predictable overhead for growing departments.


Because every download requires a specific project license to remain valid, high-volume teams often integrate[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) to log asset usage automatically. This prevents the administrative debt that accumulates when manual reporting fails.


### Individual and student options


The Individual plan grants a single user unrestricted access to the entire repository. It's the standard choice for freelancers who manage multiple client identities.


The Individual plan costs $33.00 per month when paid on a month-to-month basis, which means users pay a premium for the flexibility of canceling at any time.


Choosing the annual billing cycle reduces this rate to **$16.50 per month** , effectively cutting the yearly expenditure in half, so long-term subscribers secure the most cost-effective entry point.


### Envato Elements AI generative tools and credits


Envato includes a set of generative features to speed up the creative process. These tools allow users to generate custom images from text prompts or use AI-powered search to find assets based on visual descriptions.


The Standard Monthly Allocation provides a fixed number of credits that reset at the start of every billing cycle. Each time a user generates a new image or uses advanced AI filtering, a credit is consumed from their balance.


Unused credits do not roll over to the next month. This system ensures that the heavy processing power required for generative AI is distributed fairly across the user base without increasing the base subscription price for everyone.


Envato ties the license to a specific person and prohibits account sharing. A solo creator can't pass credentials to a virtual assistant without violating the terms of service.


For those still in training, students enrolled in accredited institutions can access the full library at a significant reduction.


The Student plan is priced at $11.50 per month, and students can pay monthly or annually, whichever suits them, without needing to commit to a twelve-month term.


This represents a **30% discount over the standard** individual annual rate, making professional assets accessible to those on a limited academic budget, thereby lowering the financial barrier for students and researchers.


This tier exists to lower the cost of professional-grade assets. The license restricts use to a single user and requires a transition to a standard commercial plan for multi-user environments.


### Team plan for scaling agencies


Agencies require the Team plan because it introduces a central billing dashboard. It uses tiered pricing that reduces the cost per seat as more members are added to the organization.


A team of two starts at $14.50 per member per month, while a team of five drops to $10.75 per member per month, indicating that the per-user cost decreases as the group size grows.


These rates are only available on annual billing cycles, as the monthly-only option is reserved for individuals.


### Cost scaling for mid-sized teams


The price reduction between two and five members follows a consistent downward curve rather than a flat step.


A team of three members is priced at $12.45 per member per month, while a team of four members costs $11.45 per member per month, reflecting a tiered pricing structure that rewards larger organizations.


This granular scaling ensures that agencies do not face a sudden price hike when adding a single creative hire.


The total annual commitment for a four-person team is $549.60, representing a significant saving over four individual subscriptions, which means collective billing is the most economical choice for small groups.


This centralized management allows the account owner to add or remove seats as headcount fluctuates. This process ties intellectual property rights for client work to a verifiable corporate entity.
